name: GiG Software PLC
summary: GiG Software Plc delivers affiliate solutions tailored for the online gambling and sports betting sectors. The company's diverse range of services features a sportsbook platform, an iGaming platform, an omnichannel solution, managed services, data analytics, logic systems, and frontend development. This enterprise was established on May 27, 2024, and its main office is situated in San Giljan, Malta.
